question: What is the literacy rate in India as per the Census of 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is **__74.04%.__**

**__source:-link__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Acc. to Census 2011, the literacy rate of India is **74.04%, **in which the **male literacy rate was 82.14% **and **female literacy is 65.46%.**
 
• **Kerala **state has the **highest literacy rate with 94.00% **and **Bihar **has the **lowest literacy rate i.e., 61.80%.**
 
• The Urban literacy rate is 84.11%, while in rural areas it was 67.77%.
 
• There is approx. 16.8% of gender literacy gap.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first complete Census in India was conducted in **1872 by Lord Mayo **but the first official Census was held in **1881 by Lord Ripon **.
 
• The census is conducted after every 10 years. It is conducted 8 times before independence and 7 times after independence.
 
• The last and 15th Census was held in 2011.
 
• Census provides the data for planning, analyzing preparations for policy framing.
